newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Eletropaulo still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Eletropaulo still a buy.

text.p: -- Credit Lyonnais Securities said it is reiterating its buy recommendation for shares of Brazilian state-owned power firm Eletropaulo.
-- "Third-quarter 1996 results are expected to show continuing improved performance," the bank said in a statement.
-- The bank said Eletropaulo, which is owned by Sao Paulo state, trades at a "substantial discount" to both the power sector and other electricity distributors.
-- Apart from its attractive valuation, the firm's shares are expected to rise as a result of Sao Paulo's just-launched privatization process, it said.
-- Credit Lyonnais added, however, that Eletropaulo's meager 1.5-percent float and limited liquidity will undermine investment in the firm, at least until its selloff.
-- Eletropaulo shares were untraded by 1302 local/1002 EDT Tuesday in Sao Paulo. Its preferred B closed Monday at 108.99 reais on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange.
